# ProtoVinci - Comprehensive Context & Specifications

ProtoVinci is a Mumbai-based, full-service technology and digital solutions agency.
Website: https://protovinci.vercel.app/
Contact: info@protovinci.com | +91 80972 23030 | Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

## Agency Overview
ProtoVinci bridges engineering rigor and creative craft. The studio builds web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, AI integrations, automation workflows, and tailored UI/UX design systems. Typical project delivery ranges between 2 to 6 weeks with direct founder access and SLA-backed maintenance.

## Services Detailed

1. Web Development
- Tech: React, Vite, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Node.js
- Scope: High-speed corporate websites, dynamic web applications, bespoke customer portals, headless CMS architectures.

2. Custom Software & SaaS
- Tech: TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, REST/GraphQL
- Scope: Multi-tenant platforms, internal enterprise tooling, custom dashboards, database design.

3. Mobile Application Development
- Tech: React Native, Expo, iOS, Android
- Scope: Native-feeling cross-platform mobile apps, offline sync, push notifications, secure authentication.

4. AI Solutions & Integrations
- Tech: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector DBs (Pinecone, pgvector)
- Scope: Custom RAG systems, customer service intelligence, automated document parsing, agentic tool workflows.

5. Business Process Automation
- Tech: Make, n8n, Zapier, Webhooks, custom Node/Python microservices
- Scope: CRM-ERP synchronisation, automated invoicing, lead qualification, operational workflows.

6. API & Systems Integration
- Tech: Stripe, Razorpay, Twilio, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, Custom APIs
- Scope: Payment gateway setup, omni-channel messaging, third-party system data synchronization.

7. UI/UX & Product Design
- Tech: Figma, Framer, Design Systems, Interactive Prototypes
- Scope: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI components, accessible WCAG-compliant design.

8. Cloud Solutions & DevOps
- Tech: AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel, Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform
- Scope: CI/CD automation, serverless setups, auto-scaling, SSL/DNS management, cost optimization.

9. Maintenance & Support
- Scope: Ongoing security patching, uptime monitoring, core dependency upgrades, performance audits.

10. Video & Motion Design
- Tech: After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve
- Scope: Product launch videos, 3D animations, social assets, brand storytelling.

## Process / How It Works
- Stage 01: Discovery & Strategy - Define requirements, scope, architecture, and timeline.
- Stage 02: Design & Prototyping - Interactive Figma prototypes and aesthetic validation.
- Stage 03: Engineering & Build - Clean, typed code with responsive layouts and buttery motion.
- Stage 04: Testing & Optimization - Cross-browser testing, accessibility (a11y) checks, SEO, performance tuning.
- Stage 05: Launch & Support - Zero-downtime deployment, analytics integration, and maintenance.
